title: Six-Round AES Versus a Three-Round Generic SPN
summary: A six-round AES distinguisher is presented, but whether six-round AES is weaker than a three-round generic SPN remains unresolved pending deeper analysis of the three-round yoyo game.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether six-round AES is weaker than a three-round generic SPN under the three-round yoyo game.

scope.domain: Reduced-round symmetric cryptanalysis comparing AES with a generic SPN in the yoyo game.
parameters: six rounds of AES: reduced-round construction under evaluation
three rounds of a generic SPN: comparison construction
three-round yoyo game: cryptanalytic game for the comparison
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether six-round AES is weaker than a three-round generic SPN under the three-round yoyo game; the source says this requires deeper analysis of that game.

progress.summary: The paper presents a six-round AES distinguisher based on impossible zero-difference conditions and reports that the authors were unable to find a generic distinguisher for three generic SP rounds. It says that establishing the relative weakness requires deeper study of the three-round yoyo game.
citation_labels: Sondre Rønjom et al., Yoyo Tricks with AES
